_description: Built-in corpora of the layout analysis. Only texts free to redistribute are listed (public domain), each with its source and licence; the codegen (tools/codegen/codegen-layout-analysis-data-js.cjs) ships their n-gram tables, never the text, in _shared/ui/layout_analysis/_generated/corpus_<id>.js. « restore_dead_key_pairs » turns the two-character spellings the old KLA conversion wrote (^e, ¨i) back into the accented letter. Other corpora of static/corpus are linked, not shipped, until their licence is known.

corpora.title: L'ingénieux chevalier Don Quichotte de la Manche (Cervantes, trad. Charles Furne)
corpora.source: Project Gutenberg, also the French corpus of Ergo-L (https://github.com/Nuclear-Squid/ergol/tree/main/corpus)
